documents.title: UGA Guidance on Acceptable Use of AI (companion to Policy 01.07.005)
documents.summary: UGA's guidance companion to Policy 01.07.005 welcomes AI use across teaching, research and operations as long as it is responsible, lawful and data-safe. It covers data privacy, approved tools, accountability and copyright, and does not address course-level student rules.
documents.stance_why: The preamble says 'The UGA community is encouraged to explore these important tools and to use them responsibly', and the rest sets conditions (law, privacy, approved tools, accountability). That is AI allowed with conditions, so permit rather than encourage alone; it sets no course-level rule so it is not delegates.

notes: Reconciled from coder A (132 units) and coder B (103 units). Policy 01.07.005 itself was not fetched (the acceptable-use guidance PDF is its companion), so only the three university-layer documents are coded; no school or computing-unit AI policy was found and course syllabi are deferred. In the CTL policies guide the sample declaration statements, sample syllabus policies and the traffic-light chart are coded as separate units (they are ready-to-adopt policy text); the repeated sentence 'please consult with me before using it' (Examples 2 and 3) and the near-repeat 'It is your responsibility to assess the validity and applicability of any GAI output used' are coded once. Navigation, the Turnitin file-size requirements and reference lists are skipped.
